      "content": "# 🌸 Anime Garden for DeepSeek Harness

[![version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-animegarden?label=dsh-plugin-animegarden&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white&color=4D6BFE)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-animegarden)
[![CI](https://github.com/yjl9903/AnimeGarden/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/yjl9903/AnimeGarden/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-plugin-animegarden)](https://github.com/yjl9903/AnimeGarden/blob/main/LICENSE)

在 DeepSeek Harness 里搜索 Anime Garden 的动画 BT 资源.

- **会话搜索**：让 AI 能搜索 Anime Garden 资源
- **搜索面板**：输入即搜, 可按字幕组和类型筛选动画资源
- **新番周历**：查看当季新番动画, 快速筛选动画资源
- **浮窗播放**：播放链接直接在 DSH 内以浮窗打开, 边看边聊
- **磁力链接打开**：资源行的磁力链接直接唤起系统默认 BT 客户端

## 安装

把下面这句发给你的 DeepSeek Harness:

```text
从 npm 安装最新版 dsh-plugin-animegarden 到当前运行的 DeepSeek Harness
```

也可以手动安装: **Plugins → Add plugin** 输入包名, 或执行 `dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-animegarden`.

安装后, 侧边栏出现 🌸 Anime Garden.

[![dsh-plugin](https://github.com/yjl9903/AnimeGarden/raw/main/assets/dsh-plugin.png)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-animegarden)

## 配置

插件行为可以在 Loader 行的 `config` 里开关 (默认值如下), 修改后需要重载插件并刷新页面:

```yaml
config:
  baseURL: https://api.animes.garden
  # KeepShare 播放链接用 DSH 内嵌浮窗打开; false 时保持浏览器新标签页
  embeddedPlayback: true
  # 磁力链接交给系统默认 BT 客户端 (面板按钮与会话卡片)
  openMagnet: true
```

从 npm 安装时, 可在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里按 id `animegarden` 覆盖 (匹配的 override 会整体替换 `config`, 记得同时写 `baseURL`).

## 更新

暂时不支持自动更新, 先在 **插件 → 已安装插件** 中卸载当前版本, 再按上面的方式安装最新版.

## 使用 npm 包

> 支持 Node.js 24+ 或提供标准 Fetch API 的浏览器环境.

```bash
npm i @animegarden/client
```

示例:

```ts
import { fetchResources } from '@animegarden/client';

// Fetch the first page of resources
const result = await fetchResources();
if (!result.ok) {
  throw result.error;
}

console.log(result.resources);

// Fetch matching resources across pages
const botan = await fetchResources({
  count: -1,
  subject: 543360,
  fansub: '喵萌奶茶屋',
  keywords: ['简日']
});

if (!botan.ok) {
  throw botan.error;
}

console.log(botan.resources);
```

更多程序示例见 [./examples/](https://github.com/yjl9903/AnimeGarden/blob/main/examples/).

常用筛选条件（取交集）：

| 字段 | 筛选逻辑 |
| --- | --- |
| `subjects` | 按 Bangumi 条目 ID 筛选，多个 ID 匹配任意一个. |
| `fansubs` / `publishers` | 分别按字幕组或发布者名称筛选，匹配任意一个；同时设置时满足任一条件即可. |
| `search` | 按番剧名或关键词搜索标题；设置后忽略 `include`. |
| `include` | 标题包含任意一个指定词，可用于按番剧名搜索. |
| `keywords` | 标题包含全部指定词，例如 `['1080p', '简日']`. |
| `exclude` | 排除标题包含任意一个指定词的资源. |
| `after` / `before` | 限定发布时间范围，包含边界时间. |

`fetchResources()` 成功返回时，包含以下字段：

| 字段 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `ok` | `true` 表示请求成功. |
| `resources` | 匹配的资源数组，去重后按发布时间从新到旧排序. |
| `pagination` | 最后取得的页码 `page`、每页条数 `pageSize`；`complete: true` 表示没有下一页. |
| `filter` | 服务端解析后实际使用的筛选条件. |
| `timestamp` | 首次成功响应的时间. |

 * The `animegarden_search_resources` tool: execution and registration.
 *
 * `executeSearchResources` maps the arguments, calls the public API through
 * `@animegarden/client`, and normalizes the result into the declared output
 * shape. `registerSearchResourcesTool` publishes that definition on the Host
 * tool registry; the registry records a scope effect on the plugin context, so
 * the tool is unregistered automatically when the plugin is unloaded or reloaded.
 */

import type {
  PluginToolContext,
  ResolvedOptions,
  ToolDefinition,
  ToolRunContext
} from '../shared/types';

import { isRecord } from '../shared/utils';
import { REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS } from '../shared/constants';

import type { SearchResult } from './types';

import { renderMarkdown } from './render';
import { buildFetchOptions } from './args';
import { mapFilter, mapResource, searchResources } from './api';
import {
  OUTPUT_SCHEMA,
  PARAMETERS_SCHEMA,
  SEARCH_RESOURCES_TOOL_NAME,
  TOOL_DESCRIPTION
} from './schema';

/**
 * Execute one `animegarden_search_resources` call: map the arguments onto client
 * options, run the search through `@animegarden/client`, and normalize the
 * result into the declared output shape.
 *
 * @param options - resolved bundle config.
 * @param rawArgs - model-supplied arguments.
 * @param exec - tool run context.
 * @returns structured result matching `OUTPUT_SCHEMA`.
 */
export async function executeSearchResources(
  options: ResolvedOptions,
  rawArgs: unknown,
  exec: ToolRunContext | undefined
): Promise<SearchResult> {
  const args = isRecord(rawArgs) ? rawArgs : {};
  const request = buildFetchOptions(options, args);
  const result = await searchResources(options, request, exec?.signal);

  return {
    filter: mapFilter(result.filter),
    pagination: result.pagination,
    timestamp: result.timestamp.toISOString(),
    resources: result.resources.map(mapResource)
  };
}

/**
 * Register the `animegarden_search_resources` tool on the Host tool registry.
 *
 * @param ctx - Cordis plugin context (with `tools` injected).
 * @param options - resolved bundle config.
 * @returns the registry's disposer (registration is already effect-scoped).
 */
export function registerSearchResourcesTool(
  ctx: PluginToolContext,
  options: ResolvedOptions
): () => void {
  const definition: ToolDefinition<SearchResult> = {
    name: SEARCH_RESOURCES_TOOL_NAME,
    description: TOOL_DESCRIPTION,
    parameters: PARAMETERS_SCHEMA,
    output: { schema: OUTPUT_SCHEMA, render: renderMarkdown },
    // Backstop for the harness timeout policy; `searchResources` enforces the
    // tighter 15 s budget cooperatively so a slow API yields a readable error.
    timeoutMs: REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS + 5_000,
    isConcurrencySafe: () => true,
    execute: (args, exec) => executeSearchResources(options, args, exec)
  };

  return ctx.tools.register(definition);
}

  inject(slot: string, declare: () => unknown): unknown;

  register<P>(options: SlotRegistrationOptions, component: ComponentType<P>): () => void;
}

  slots: SlotService;

  inject: string[];

 * dependency: the module loader provides it and `react.ts` shares that one instance.
 * @param ReactRuntime - the browser React module supplied by the loader factory.
 * @returns the Cordis client plugin object: required services plus `apply`.
 */
export function createPlugin(ReactRuntime: typeof ReactNamespace): AnimeGardenPlugin {
  setReact(ReactRuntime);

  // One client for the plugin lifetime; the panel wraps itself in its provider.
  const queryClient = new QueryClient({
    defaultOptions: {

        refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
        staleTime: 60_000
      }
    }

  /** Keep panel and conversation feedback visible independently of the selected panel. */
  function AnimeGardenToaster() {
    return ReactRuntime.createElement(Toaster, { position: 'bottom-right', theme: 'system' });
  }

    inject: ['slots', 'locale'],

      if (options.embeddedPlayback) registerPlaybackFeature(ctx, t);

    }
  };

 * Global magnet-link routing for the Web UI.
 *
 * Any `magnet:` anchor rendered in the Harness page — the Anime Garden panel's
 * download action and the chat result card's magnet button — is routed to the
 * Host's open-magnet route, which hands the URI to the OS default BitTorrent
 * client. One capture-phase document listener covers every surface, so the
 * behavior does not depend on which plugin or slot rendered the link.
 *
 * The Harness Markdown renderer only keeps `http:`/`https:`/`mailto:` anchors,
 * so model-written magnet links arrive here as plain text, not anchors; the
 * panel and other plugin views are the surfaces this interceptor can reach.
 */

import { toast } from 'sonner';

import type { ClientContext } from '../index.js';
import type { TranslateFunction } from '../i18n.js';

import { isMagnetUri, OPEN_MAGNET_PATH } from '../../shared/magnet';

/** Attribute stamped on plugin-rendered magnet links (keeps their click analytics). */
export const MAGNET_LINK_ATTRIBUTE = 'data-agp-magnet-link';

/** One open attempt: `ok` only when the Host reported a successful hand-off. */
export interface MagnetOpenResult {
  ok: boolean;
  /** Failure detail from the route or the network; empty on success. */
  message: string;
}

/** Narrow an unknown JSON body to a message-bearing record. */
function failureMessage(body: unknown, fallback: string): string {
  if (typeof body !== 'object' || body === null) return fallback;
  const message = (body as Record<string, unknown>).message;
  return typeof message === 'string' && message !== '' ? message : fallback;
}

/**
 * Ask the Host to open one magnet URI with the OS default application.
 *
 * @param magnet - validated magnet URI.
 * @returns the route's outcome; failures are reported instead of thrown.
 */
export async function openMagnet(magnet: string): Promise<MagnetOpenResult> {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(OPEN_MAGNET_PATH, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ magnet })
    });
    if (response.ok) return { ok: true, message: '' };

    let message = `HTTP ${String(response.status)}`;
    try {
      message = failureMessage(await response.json(), message);
    } catch {
      // A non-JSON failure body keeps the status text.
    }
    return { ok: false, message };
  } catch (error) {
    return { ok: false, message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) };
  }
}

/**
 * Route every magnet-anchor click in the document into the Host opener.
 *
 * Modified and non-primary clicks stay untouched so the panel's own
 * modifier-click copy behavior can run; the plugin's own anchors keep bubbling
 * for their click analytics, while foreign anchors stop propagating so no other
 * link handler also tries to open the same URI.
 *
 * @param open - action that hands one validated magnet URI to the Host.
 * @returns the disposer removing the listener when the plugin unloads.
 */
export function installMagnetLinkInterceptor(open: (magnet: string) => void): () => void {
  const onClick = (event: MouseEvent): void => {
    if (event.defaultPrevented || event.button !== 0) return;
    if (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey) return;

    const node = event.target instanceof Element ? event.target : null;
    const anchor = node?.closest('a[href]');
    if (!(anchor instanceof HTMLAnchorElement)) return;

    const magnet = anchor.getAttribute('href') ?? '';
    if (!isMagnetUri(magnet)) return;

    event.preventDefault();
    if (!anchor.hasAttribute(MAGNET_LINK_ATTRIBUTE)) event.stopPropagation();
    open(magnet);
  };

  document.addEventListener('click', onClick, true);
  return () => document.removeEventListener('click', onClick, true);
}

/**
 * Mount the global magnet-link routing on the Client context.
 *
 * @param ctx - Client plugin context owning the listener's lifetime.
 * @param t - translate seat bound to the plugin namespace.
 */
export function registerMagnetFeature(ctx: ClientContext, t: TranslateFunction): void {
  ctx.effect(
    () =>
      installMagnetLinkInterceptor((magnet) => {
        void openMagnet(magnet).then((result) => {
          if (!result.ok) toast.error(t('openMagnetFailed'));
        });
      }),
    'animegarden: magnet link interceptor'
  );
}

const OPENER_OUTPUT_BYTES = 4 * 1024;

/** Exit grace handed to the subprocess provider for the opener. */
const OPENER_GRACE_MS = 1_000;

/**
 * The Host process facts this module reads.
 *
 * Declared locally so the dependency-free bundle needs no Node type package;
 * the values are the standard Node globals at the plugin's runtime.
 */
declare const process: { platform: string; cwd(): string };

/** One platform's way to hand a URI to its registered application. */
interface UriLauncher {
  /** Executable name resolved through the exec-world PATH. */
  command: string;
  /** Arguments appended after the executable; the URI is the last one. */
  prefix: string[];
}

/**
 * Pick the platform's URI opener.
 *
 * Windows uses `rundll32`'s FileProtocolHandler instead of `cmd /c start`,
 * because a magnet URI carries `&` query separators that a command shell would
 * split into separate commands; the opener receives the URI as one argv item.
 *
 * @param platform - `process.platform` from the Host process.
 * @returns the launcher, or `null` for a platform this plugin cannot open.
 */
function launcherFor(platform: string): UriLauncher | null {
  if (platform === 'darwin') return { command: 'open', prefix: [] };
  if (platform === 'win32')
    return { command: 'rundll32.exe', prefix: ['url.dll,FileProtocolHandler'] };
  if (platform === 'linux') return { command: 'xdg-open', prefix: [] };
  return null;
}

/** Sentinel returned when the opener has not exited inside the launch window. */
const LAUNCH_TIMEOUT = Symbol('launch-timeout');

/**
 * Race one promise against the launch window.
 * @param promise - the opener's completion promise.
 * @returns the promise's value, or {@link LAUNCH_TIMEOUT}.
 */
async function raceLaunchWindow<T>(promise: Promise<T>): Promise<T | typeof LAUNCH_TIMEOUT> {
  const timeout = new Promise<typeof LAUNCH_TIMEOUT>((resolve) => {
    setTimeout(() => resolve(LAUNCH_TIMEOUT), LAUNCH_TIMEOUT_MS);
  });
  return Promise.race([promise, timeout]);
}

/**
 * Read one collected stream's bounded text without throwing.
 * @param handle - the finished opener.
 * @returns the captured standard error, or an empty string.
 */
function openerStderr(handle: SubprocessHandle): string {
  try {
    return (handle.collected?.stderr?.readFrom(0).text ?? '').trim();
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
}

/**
 * Launch the OS handler for one magnet URI.
 *
 * A non-zero exit is the opener's own failure report (for example macOS
 * `open` finding no registered BitTorrent client), so it becomes the route's
 * error message. A still-running opener after the launch window counts as a
 * successful hand-off and is not killed.
 *
 * @param ctx - Host context carrying the subprocess service.
 * @param magnet - validated magnet URI.
 * @throws when the platform has no opener, resolution fails, or the opener exits non-zero.
 */
async function launchMagnet(ctx: HostWebContext, magnet: string): Promise<void> {
  const launcher = launcherFor(process.platform);
  if (launcher === null) throw new Error(`unsupported platform: ${process.platform}`);

  const executable = await ctx.subprocess.resolveExecutable(launcher.command);
  const handle = ctx.subprocess.spawn({
    argv: [executable, ...launcher.prefix, magnet],
    cwd: process.cwd(),
    stdio: {
      stdin: 'ignore',
      stdout: { maxBytes: OPENER_OUTPUT_BYTES },
      stderr: { maxBytes: OPENER_OUTPUT_BYTES }
    },
    graceMs: OPENER_GRACE_MS
  });

  const outcome = await raceLaunchWindow(handle.done);
  if (outcome === LAUNCH_TIMEOUT) return;
  if (outcome.exitCode === 0) return;

  const stderr = openerStderr(handle);
  const detail = stderr !== '' ? stderr : `exit code ${String(outcome.exitCode)}`;
  throw new Error(`the system could not open the magnet link (${detail})`);
}

/** Write one JSON response without caching the launch outcome. */
function sendJson(
  response: WebRouteResponse,
  status: number,
  payload: Record<string, unknown>
): void {
  response.statusCode = status;
  response.setHeader('content-type', 'application/json; charset=utf-8');
  response.setHeader('cache-control', 'no-store');
  response.end(JSON.stringify(payload));
}

/** 405 with the route's single supported method. */
function sendMethodNotAllowed(response: WebRouteResponse): void {
  response.statusCode = 405;
  response.setHeader('allow', 'POST');
  response.end();
}

/**
 * Collect a bounded UTF-8 request body.
 * @param request - the incoming request.
 * @returns the body text, or `null` when it exceeds the ceiling.
 */
async function readBoundedBody(request: WebRouteRequest): Promise<string | null> {
  const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let size = 0;
  for await (const chunk of request) {
    size += chunk.byteLength;
    if (size > MAX_BODY_BYTES) return null;
    chunks.push(chunk);
  }
  return new TextDecoder().decode(chunkBytes(chunks));
}

/** Concatenate body chunks into one byte array. */
function chunkBytes(chunks: Uint8Array[]): Uint8Array {
  if (chunks.length === 1) return chunks[0];
  const total = chunks.reduce((sum, chunk) => sum + chunk.byteLength, 0);
  const merged = new Uint8Array(total);
  let offset = 0;
  for (const chunk of chunks) {
    merged.set(chunk, offset);
    offset += chunk.byteLength;
  }
  return merged;
}

/**
 * Validate the request body: a JSON object whose only meaningful field is a
 * magnet URI.
 * @param text - request body text.
 * @returns the validated URI, or `null`.
 */
function parseMagnetBody(text: string): string | null {
  let body: unknown;
  try {
    body = JSON.parse(text);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  if (typeof body !== 'object' || body === null) return null;
  const magnet = (body as Record<string, unknown>).magnet;
  return typeof magnet === 'string' && isMagnetUri(magnet) ? magnet : null;
}

/**
 * Answer one open-magnet request.
 *
 * The trust fence runs first: the connection service applies the deployment's
 * Host/Origin checks and browser authentication, so an unauthenticated caller
 * never reaches validation or a process spawn.
 *
 * @param ctx - Host context carrying the web server, connection, and subprocess services.
 * @param request - the incoming request.
 * @param response - the response owned by this route.
 */
async function handleOpenMagnet(
  ctx: HostWebContext,
  request: WebRouteRequest,
  response: WebRouteResponse
): Promise<void> {
  const rejection = ctx.connection.requestRejection(request);
  if (rejection !== undefined) {
    response.statusCode = rejection;
    response.end();
    return;
  }

  if ((request.method ?? '').toUpperCase() !== 'POST') {
    sendMethodNotAllowed(response);
    return;
  }

  const contentType = String(request.headers['content-type'] ?? '')
    .split(';', 1)[0]
    ?.trim()
    .toLowerCase();
  if (contentType !== 'application/json') {
    sendJson(response, 415, {
      code: 'unsupported-media-type',
      message: 'content-type must be application/json'
    });
    return;
  }

  let text: string | null;
  try {
    text = await readBoundedBody(request);
  } catch {
    sendJson(response, 400, { code: 'bad-request', message: 'request body unreadable' });
    return;
  }
  if (text === null) {
    sendJson(response, 413, { code: 'payload-too-large', message: 'request body is too large' });
    return;
  }

  const magnet = parseMagnetBody(text);
  if (magnet === null) {
    sendJson(response, 400, {
      code: 'invalid-magnet',
      message: 'request body must be JSON with a BitTorrent magnet URI in "magnet"'
    });
    return;
  }

  try {
    await launchMagnet(ctx, magnet);
    sendJson(response, 200, { ok: true });
  } catch (error) {
    sendJson(response, 502, {
      code: 'launch-failed',
      message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
    });
  }
}

/**
 * Register the open-magnet route on the Harness web server.
 *
 * Runs only when the web, connection, and subprocess services are all present,
 * so the plugin keeps providing its search tool in CLI/headless profiles.
 *
 * @param ctx - Host context with the required services.
 */
export function registerOpenMagnetRoute(ctx: HostWebContext): void {
  ctx.effect(
    () =>
      ctx.webServer.register({
        kind: 'exact',
        path: OPEN_MAGNET_PATH,
        handler: (request, response) => handleOpenMagnet(ctx, request, response)
      }),
    'animegarden: open magnet route'
  );
}

 * Umami analytics for the Web panel.
 *
 * The website loads the Umami script and calls `window.umami.track(...)`, which a
 * plugin cannot do (no script injection, no global tracker). This module posts the
 * same collect payload the script sends to `/api/send`, so the same website id and
 * the same dashboards keep working.
 *
 * Event names and field names mirror `apps/web/src/utils/umami.ts` exactly.
 */

const UMAMI_ENDPOINT = 'https://umami.animes.garden/api/send';

/** Public website id used by https://animes.garden. */
const UMAMI_WEBSITE = 'bcff225d-6590-498e-9b39-3a5fc5c2b4d1';

/** Keep DSH-plugin traffic attributable to the public website host. */
const UMAMI_HOSTNAME = 'animes.garden';

/** Stable synthetic page URL for the panel (there is no real web route). */
const PANEL_URL = 'https://animes.garden/_/dsh-plugin';

/** Umami `tag` attached to every payload, marking DeepSeek Harness plugin traffic. */
const SOURCE_TAG = 'dsh-plugin';

/** Event payloads mirrored from the website's Umami schema. */
export interface TrackEventMap {
  'search.trigger': {
    text: string;
    source: 'button' | 'command' | 'history' | 'result-more';
  };
  pikpak: { resource: string; source: string };
  download: { resource: string; source: string };
  'resources.detail.click': { resource: string; type: string };
  'resources.filter.click': {
    filterType: 'type' | 'fansub' | 'publisher';
    value: string;
  };
  'anime.calendar.click': { subjectId: string; title: string; weekday: string };
  'error.fetch-resources': { path: string; error: string };
}

/** Literal event names supported by {@link track}. */
export type TrackEventName = keyof TrackEventMap;

/** Common Umami fields the collect endpoint expects alongside the event. */
function basePayload(title = ''): Record<string, string> {
  const screen =
    typeof window.screen === 'undefined' ? '' : `${window.screen.width}x${window.screen.height}`;

  return {
    website: UMAMI_WEBSITE,
    screen,
    language: typeof navigator === 'undefined' ? '' : navigator.language,
    title: title || (typeof document === 'undefined' ? '' : document.title),
    hostname: UMAMI_HOSTNAME,
    url: PANEL_URL,
    referrer: '',
    tag: SOURCE_TAG
  };
}

/** POST one collect payload, silently ignoring network/CORS failures. */
function send(body: { type: 'event' | 'pageview'; payload: Record<string, unknown> }): void {
  try {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    void fetch(UMAMI_ENDPOINT, {
      method: 'POST',
      keepalive: true,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'x-umami-website-id': UMAMI_WEBSITE,
        'x-umami-hostname': UMAMI_HOSTNAME
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(body)
    }).catch(() => undefined);
  } catch {
    // Analytics must never break the panel.
  }
}

/**
 * Send one Umami event without ever interrupting the user action that triggered it.
 * @param name - event name, identical to the website's analytics event.
 * @param payload - event fields, identical to the website's payload schema.
 */
export function track<E extends TrackEventName>(name: E, payload: TrackEventMap[E]): void {
  send({ type: 'event', payload: { ...basePayload(), name, data: payload } });
}

/**
 * Report one panel pageview.
 *
 * This Umami deployment records pageviews as a nameless `event` (its tracker sends
 * `G()` → `{...payload}` with `type: 'event'`); `/api/send` rejects `pageview` as a
 * type, so the PV is sent the same way the website's tracker does.
 */
export function trackPageview(): void {
  send({ type: 'event', payload: basePayload('Anime Garden') });
}

/**
 * Register every Host capability of the bundle.
 *
 * The web-facing capabilities go through optional injection: they need the web
 * server, the connection trust fence, and the subprocess service, so a
 * CLI/headless profile keeps the search tool without them. The options
 * injection always runs there (the Client needs the flags even when the magnet
 * route is disabled); the magnet route itself only exists when `openMagnet`
 * is enabled.
 *
 * @param ctx - Cordis plugin context (with `tools` injected).
 * @param options - resolved bundle config.
 * @returns the tool registry disposer.
 */
export function registerAnimeGardenTools(
  ctx: PluginToolContext,
  options: ResolvedOptions
): () => void {
  const disposer = registerSearchResourcesTool(ctx, options);

  ctx.inject?.(['webServer', 'connection', 'subprocess'], (web) => {
    registerOptionsInjection(web, options);
    if (options.openMagnet) registerOpenMagnetRoute(web);
  });

  return disposer;
